subject: general
question: Rajesh has 156 litres of Oil A and 256 litres of Oil B. He fills a number of identical containers with the two types of oil in a manner that each container has only one type of oil, and all containers are completely filled. What can be the maximum volume (in litres) of each container that Rajesh uses, so that all the oil that Rajesh has, of both the types, can be poured into these containers?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To find the **maximum volume** of identical containers, we must find the **HCF (Highest Common Factor)** of the given quantities.

Quantities: 156 and 256.

HCF(156, 256) ⇒ Difference = 256 − 156 = 100.

Factors of 100 are 1, 2, 4, 5, 10, 20, 25, 50, 100. Checking the largest factor that divides both 156 and 256.

156 is divisible by 4, and 256 is divisible by 4. Larger factors of 100 do not divide 156.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 litres.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Volume of **Oil A** = 156 litres

Volume of **Oil B** = 256 litres

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/420350598e7d52d08772551e5d9b85cb2e3fa5351d7d47fa61d2307c8bb51015.png] 

**Calculation:**

To find the **maximum capacity** of each container, calculate the **HCF** of 156 and 256.

Prime factorization of 156:

⇒ 156 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 13 = 2² × 3 × 13

Prime factorization of 256:

⇒ 256 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 = 2⁸

HCF is the product of the lowest powers of common prime factors:

⇒ HCF = 2²

⇒ HCF = 4

**∴ The correct answer is 4 litres.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Highest Common Factor (HCF)

HCF is the greatest number that divides two or more numbers without leaving a remainder. It is also known as GCF or GCD.

Least Common Multiple (LCM)

LCM is the smallest non-zero common multiple of two or more numbers. Relationship: Product of two numbers = HCF × LCM.

Application in Partitioning

When items need to be divided into the largest possible equal groups or containers without mixing, HCF is always the required value.</p
